name: Wraith
fantasy: A horned spirit in chains that never touches the ground. Tears souls out with spectral claws, drains them down a tether, steps through shadow, drags foes into the earth's grasp and brings down the night.

directions.name: Render
directions.desc: The claws: Spectral Rend, quick strikes and cruel crits.

directions.name: Shadow
directions.desc: The tether and the mist: Soul Siphon and Shadowstep.

directions.name: Night
directions.desc: What comes out of the dark: Haunting Grasp, Phantom Assault and Eternal Night.

skills.name: Spectral Rend
skills.desc: Lunge at the foe ahead and tear through it with elongated spectral claws: two rakes for 90% weapon damage each. Every soul the claws tear out flies back and heals you.

skills.name: Soul Siphon
skills.desc: Reach out and hook a spectral tether into an enemy: for 2.5 seconds it stands rigid while the tether drains it (about 180% weapon damage in all) and heals you a third of what it takes, and it is slowed after. A soul torn loose heals you more. The tether holds while you fight on.

skills.name: Shadow Step
skills.desc: Come apart into mist and re-form at the cursor, spinning into a claw strike round where you land for 130% weapon damage. For a moment after, blows pass through you. The shade you left behind collapses and hurts.

skills.name: Haunting Grasp
skills.desc: Slam the ground: spectral hands burst out of the earth around the cursor, seizing every enemy within 3.5 metres for 110% weapon damage, dragging them inward and holding them fast for 2.5 seconds.

skills.name: Phantom Assault
skills.desc: Split into three phantoms that streak through the enemies ahead in a fan, each tearing everything in its path for 120% weapon damage, then strike with your own claws.

skills.name: Eternal Night
skills.desc: Rise and bring down the night over 9 metres: a scream of terror (150% weapon damage, enemies hurled back and frozen with fear), then the dark feeds on everything in it while you hang untouchable above it, and it collapses into your slam for 200%. +40% damage for 12 seconds.

rites.name: Soul Harvest
rites.text: Each soul Spectral Rend tears out heals {rend_heal}% more of your life.

rites.name: Cruelty
rites.text: +{crit}% chance to land a critical hit.

rites.name: Harvest Moon
rites.text: Spectral Rend's claws tear all the way round you.

rites.name: Slipstream
rites.text: Shadowstep recharges {cd:step}% faster and strikes {dmg:step}% harder.

rites.name: Hollow Hunger
rites.text: Soul Siphon costs {cost:siphon}% less mana and recharges {cd:siphon}% faster.

rites.name: Lingering Mist
rites.text: After Shadowstep you stay mist {veil} seconds longer, and its strike stuns {step_stun} seconds longer.

rites.name: Legion
rites.text: Phantom Assault and Haunting Grasp strike {dmg:phantom}% harder.

rites.name: Eternal
rites.text: Eternal Night's power lasts {buff_dur} seconds longer and Haunting Grasp holds {grasp_hold} seconds longer.

rites.name: Soul Siphon
rites.text: +{ls}% of the damage you deal comes back as life.

rites.name: Fourth Rider
rites.text: Phantom Assault sends a fourth phantom, and Eternal Night deals {dmg:night}% more damage.
